glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 上述问题如果今天还没有结果，明天开会的时候大家还得从头再说一遍。
报告最后一页写得很清楚，上述安排不是临时决定的，而是讨论了很久才定下来。
老师提醒大家，答题时如果只重复上述理由，却没有自己的分析，分数不会太高。

example_translations.translation: If the above-mentioned issue still has no result today, everyone will have to go over it again from the beginning at tomorrow's meeting.
The last page of the report makes it clear that the above-mentioned arrangement was not a last-minute decision, but something settled only after long discussion.
The teacher reminded everyone that if they only repeat the above-mentioned reasons in their answer without any analysis of their own, the score will not be very high.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 孩子第一次上台以前一直抓着老师的手，后来听见下面有人给他鼓掌，才敢慢慢开口。
她本来不想上台发言，可是主持人已经叫到名字了，她只好拿着纸走到前面。
老演员上台以前先站在门后深呼吸，因为他知道今天来的观众比平时多得多。

example_translations.translation: Before taking the stage for the first time, the child kept holding the teacher's hand; only after hearing people below applaud did he dare slowly begin to speak.
She had not wanted to go on stage to speak, but the host had already called her name, so she had no choice but to take her paper and walk to the front.
Before going on stage, the veteran actor stood behind the door and took deep breaths, because he knew there were far more audience members than usual today.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 公司准备在五月上旬搬办公室，所以这几天大家一直在整理以前放着没动的东西。
医生说药先吃到下月上旬，如果那时候还一直咳，就再回来检查一次。
旅行社原来想把出发时间定在十月上旬，后来因为天气变化太快，才改到月底。

example_translations.translation: The company plans to move offices in the early part of May, so everyone has been sorting through things that had been left untouched for a long time.
The doctor said to keep taking the medicine until the early part of next month, and if the cough is still there then, come back for another check.
The travel agency had originally wanted to set the departure date for the early part of October, but later moved it to the end of the month because the weather was changing too quickly.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这个图书馆每个周末都有少儿节目，周围很多家长吃过早饭就带孩子过去等开门。
医院大厅新开的少儿门诊地方不大，可是医生说话很慢，所以孩子进去以后不太害怕。
社区准备办新的少儿课程以前，先请家长写下最想让孩子学什么。

example_translations.translation: Every weekend this library has programs for children, and many parents nearby bring their kids over after breakfast and wait for the doors to open.
The new children's clinic in the hospital lobby is not large, but the doctor speaks very slowly, so the children are not too scared after going in.
Before the community starts the new children's classes, it first asks parents to write down what they most want their children to learn.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 孩子喝汤太急，一下就把舌头烫到了，后来半天都不肯再吃东西。
医生让他先伸出舌头看看，又问他这几天是不是一直觉得嘴里没有味道。
她太紧张的时候说话总会咬到舌头，所以重要的发言以前都会先自己练几遍。

example_translations.translation: The child drank the soup too fast and burned his tongue at once; afterward he refused to eat anything for quite a while.
The doctor asked him to stick out his tongue first, then asked whether he had felt that his mouth had no taste these past few days.
When she gets too nervous, she always bites her tongue while speaking, so before important talks she practices by herself several times first.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 他大学一年级就进了文学社，因为比起参加比赛，他更想和别人一起写东西。
报社的人下午又来找他，希望他把那天看到的情况按时间顺序再说得详细一点。
这条消息刚出来，通讯社的人就赶到现场，一边拍照一边向周围的人问清时间。

example_translations.translation: He joined the literature club in his first year of college, because more than entering competitions, he wanted to write with other people.
People from the newspaper office came to see him again in the afternoon, hoping he could describe in more detail, in time order, what he had seen that day.
As soon as the news came out, people from the news agency rushed to the scene, taking pictures and asking the people around them to pin down the time.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 早上太阳一出来，阳光就从窗边射到地上，连墙上的画都一下亮了很多。
他一着急就把箭射到草里了，大家找了半天才看见它卡在石头旁边。
后面的车灯突然射过来，他一下看不清前面的路，只好先慢慢把车停下。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the sun came up in the morning, the sunlight shot onto the floor from the window, and even the painting on the wall suddenly became much brighter.
In his panic he shot the arrow into the grass, and everyone searched for a long time before seeing it stuck beside a stone.
The car lights from behind suddenly beamed over, and he could not see the road ahead clearly, so he had to slow down and stop the car first.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 这件事不仅涉及钱，还涉及好几个人以前答应过的安排，所以谁也不敢马上说话。
经理说这次调整不仅涉及工资，还涉及以后谁负责哪一部分工作，所以不能今天随便定。
这个问题表面上看很小，其实涉及学校、家长和孩子三方面，所以谁都不能只看自己。

example_translations.translation: This matter involves not only money, but also arrangements that several people had agreed to before, so no one dared speak right away.
The manager said this adjustment involves not only salaries, but also who will be responsible for each part of the work later, so it cannot be decided casually today.
This issue looks small on the surface, but it actually involves the school, the parents, and the children, so no one can look only at their own side.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 比赛场地很安静，第一次参加射击比赛的人站在那里，连自己呼吸的声音都听得很清楚。
比赛开始以前，教练一再提醒队员，射击最怕心急，呼吸一乱手就会跟着动。
这个地方原来只办普通课程，后来因为报名的人越来越多，才加了少儿射击课。

example_translations.translation: The competition range was very quiet; the people entering a shooting competition for the first time could even hear the sound of their own breathing very clearly standing there.
Before the competition started, the coach repeatedly reminded the team that shooting fears impatience most; once your breathing becomes uneven, your hand will move with it.
This place used to offer only ordinary classes, but later, as more and more people signed up, it added a children's shooting class.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 婚礼开始以前，负责摄像的人先把灯光和位置都看好，怕到时候有人站起来挡住镜头。
导演说这一段只拍一次，所以摄像的时候谁都不要在旁边随便走动。
小店门口这几天一直有人摄像，老板开始还不明白，后来才知道电视台在做节目。

example_translations.translation: Before the wedding started, the person in charge of filming first checked the lighting and the position, afraid that someone might stand up and block the lens when the time came.
The director said this section would be filmed only once, so while the camera was rolling, no one should walk around casually nearby.
For the past few days someone has been filming at the entrance to the small shop; at first the owner did not understand, and only later learned that a TV station was making a program.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 他原来设想这趟出差会很顺利，没想到刚下车就碰上暴雨，后面的安排全乱了。
经理的设想听上去很好，可是真正做起来的时候，每一步都比纸上写的更麻烦。
她常常设想自己以后住在海边的小城，早上开窗就能看见船慢慢从远处过来。

example_translations.translation: He had imagined that this business trip would go smoothly, but he ran into a rainstorm as soon as he got off the bus, and all the plans after that were thrown into disorder.
The manager's conception sounds very good, but when it actually comes time to do it, every step is more troublesome than it looked on paper.
She often imagines herself living in a small seaside town one day, opening the window in the morning and seeing boats slowly come from the distance.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 商店门口新装的摄像头角度很高，所以谁在门前停了多久，回头一看就很清楚。
楼下的摄像头昨天晚上突然黑了一会儿，所以保安今天一直在查是哪根线松了。
小区里原来没有摄像头，后来总有人说车找不到，大家才同意在楼下装几个。

example_translations.translation: The newly installed camera above the shop entrance has a very high angle, so a quick look back shows clearly who stopped at the door and for how long.
The camera downstairs went dark for a while last night, so the security guard has been checking all day to see which wire came loose.
There used to be no cameras in the complex, but later people kept saying they could not find their cars, and only then did everyone agree to install a few downstairs.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 长时间不休息不仅会让人很累，对身心的影响也会慢慢表现出来，所以医生一直劝他早点睡。
老师带学生去山里住了几天，希望大家先离开手机，好让身心都安静下来。
她那段时间工作太多，后来请了几天假以后，身心状态才慢慢恢复正常。

example_translations.translation: Long periods without rest not only make a person tired; the effects on body and mind also slowly show themselves, which is why the doctor kept urging him to sleep earlier.
The teacher took the students to stay in the mountains for a few days, hoping everyone would first get away from their phones so that both body and mind could quiet down.
She had too much work during that period, and only after taking a few days off did her physical and mental state slowly return to normal.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 深夜的站台没什么人说话，只有广播偶尔响一下，让等车的人更加清醒。
他常常忙到深夜才回家，饭虽然早就凉了，母亲还是会坐在灯下等他回来。
深夜外面突然下起很大的雨，住在旧楼里的人都怕窗上的玻璃被风吹下来。

example_translations.translation: At the late-night platform, hardly anyone was speaking; only the broadcast sounded once in a while, making the people waiting for the train even more awake.
He often worked until late at night before coming home. Although the food was already cold, his mother would still sit under the light waiting for him to return.
Late at night, heavy rain suddenly started outside, and the people living in the old building were all afraid the wind would blow down the glass in the window.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun, adjective.

examples.sentence: 孩子问父亲，故事里的神为什么什么都知道，父亲笑着说那只是人想出来的。
画里的神看着很严肃，孩子站在前面问了很多问题，老师只好慢慢给他解释。
奶奶心里有事的时候，总喜欢对着画里的神说几句话，说完以后人会轻松一点。

example_translations.translation: The child asked his father why the god in the story knew everything, and his father smiled and said that was only something people imagined.
The god in the painting looked very severe. The child stood in front of it and asked many questions, and the teacher had to explain them slowly.
When Grandma has something on her mind, she always likes to say a few words to the god in the painting, saying that after doing so she feels a little more relaxed.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 医生先按了按他的手臂，又问疼的地方是不是顺着神经一直到手指。
考试前那几天她神经一直很紧，连别人开门的声音都能把她吓一跳。
这次手术虽然不大，位置离神经太近，所以医生做决定以前看了很久片子。

example_translations.translation: The doctor first pressed his arm and then asked whether the pain ran all the way down the nerve to his fingers.
During the days before the exam, her nerves were so tight that even the sound of someone opening a door could startle her.
Although the operation was not a major one, it was too close to the nerve, so the doctor studied the scans for a long time before deciding.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 这块旧表看着很普通，修好以后却一点没慢，父亲越看越觉得神奇。
山里这口井看着很普通，可是不管天气多热，里面的水一直都那么凉，真有点神奇。
医生说这不是神奇的药，只是他按时休息、认真吃药，所以身体才慢慢好起来。

example_translations.translation: This old watch looked ordinary, but after it was fixed it was not even a little slow, and the father found it more and more magical the longer he looked at it.
This well in the mountains looks very ordinary, yet no matter how hot the weather gets, the water inside stays that cool all the time; it really is a little magical.
The doctor said this was not a magical medicine; it was just that he rested on time and took the medicine seriously, so his body slowly got better.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 老师说提高审美不能只看别人怎么选，还要自己多看、多想，慢慢才会有判断。
她和姐姐喜欢的颜色一直不一样，所以两个人谈到审美的时候常常意见完全相反。
做这个工作的人不仅要懂技术，还要有审美，不然东西再贵也不一定好看。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that improving your sense of beauty cannot depend only on watching how others choose; you also have to look more and think more yourself before you slowly develop judgment.
She and her older sister have always liked different colors, so when the two of them talk about aesthetics, their opinions are often completely opposite.
People who do this work not only need to understand the technical side, they also need aesthetic sense; otherwise, something can be expensive and still not look good.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as measure word.

examples.sentence: 这桶水差不多有二十升，两个孩子一起抬的时候还一直说手酸，可是谁也不肯先放下。
医生让他每天至少喝两升水，因为天气太热，再像以前那样喝得少很容易头疼。
这台旧车虽然还能开，每跑一百公里却要多烧两升油，所以大家都劝他早点换掉。

example_translations.translation: This bucket holds about twenty liters of water. When the two children carried it together, they kept saying their hands hurt, but neither was willing to set it down first.
The doctor told him to drink at least two liters of water a day, because the weather was too hot, and drinking as little as before would easily give him a headache.
Although this old car can still run, it burns two extra liters of fuel every hundred kilometers, so everyone keeps urging him to replace it soon.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 电脑把资料整理好以后，会自动生成一张表，方便大家直接比较前后变化。
这种图片不是画出来的，而是系统根据输入的信息一点一点生成的。
如果名字写错了，系统生成的证件也会跟着出问题，所以提交以前一定要再看一遍。

example_translations.translation: After the computer organizes the data, it automatically generates a table, making it easy for everyone to compare the before and after directly.
This picture was not drawn by hand, but generated bit by bit by the system from the information that was entered.
If the name is written wrong, the document generated by the system will also have problems, so you must look it over again before submitting.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 老师说这个字本身不难，真正让外国学生头疼的是声调一变，意思也会跟着变。
他平时背词很快，可是一开口就把声调放错，所以听的人常常要再问一遍。
录音里老师把四个声调读得很慢，学生跟着练了很多次，终于能分清差别了。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said the character itself was not hard; what really gives foreign students a headache is that once the tone changes, the meaning changes with it.
He memorizes words quickly, but as soon as he opens his mouth he puts the tone wrong, so people listening often have to ask again.
In the recording, the teacher read the four tones very slowly, and after following along many times, the students were finally able to tell the difference clearly.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这棵树去年冬天看着快不行了，可是春天一到又长出很多新的叶子，生命力真让人佩服。
老人退休以后还坚持学新东西，大家最佩服的不是他记得快，而是他一直往前走的生命力。
这条旧街虽然房子不新，每天一早却有人开门做生意，所以总让人觉得很有生命力。

example_translations.translation: This tree looked close to dying last winter, but as soon as spring came it put out many new leaves again; its vitality is really admirable.
After retiring, the old man still kept learning new things. What everyone admired most was not that he remembered things quickly, but the vitality with which he kept moving forward.
Although the houses on this old street are not new, people open up for business every morning, so it always makes people feel that the place is full of vitality.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这片河边原来鱼很多，后来工地一多，大家才慢慢意识到这里的生态已经不一样了。
专家提醒大家，旅游的人一多，如果只顾方便不管垃圾，这里的生态很快就会受影响。
以前这片山上只有石头和土，后来树慢慢长起来以后，整个生态才一点一点恢复。

example_translations.translation: There used to be many fish by this riverbank, but once construction sites multiplied, people gradually realized that the ecology here had already changed.
Experts reminded everyone that once tourists become numerous, if people care only about convenience and not about the trash, the ecology here will very quickly be affected.
In the past there had been only rocks and dirt on this mountain, but after trees slowly began to grow, the whole ecology gradually recovered.

glosses.primary_gloss: to go on to higher education
glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 孩子到了升学那几个月，家里连看电视的声音都放得比平时小，怕影响他休息。
老师提醒家长，升学很重要，可是如果孩子天天只睡几个小时，最后反而更难学好。
他们说到孩子升学的时候才发现，两家的想法虽然差不多，想走的路却完全不一样。

example_translations.translation: In the months when the child was preparing to move on to the next school level, the family even kept the television quieter than usual, afraid of affecting his rest.
The teacher reminded the parents that moving on in school is important, but if a child sleeps only a few hours every day, it will instead become even harder to study well in the end.

Only when they started talking about the children's advancement to the next school stage did they realize that although the two families thought similarly, the paths they wanted to take were completely different.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 工人清点材料时发现，真正还能再用的剩余材料并不多，所以明天还得再送一车来。
厨房把晚饭做完以后，剩余的菜都另外放好，第二天来得早的人还能继续吃。
老板把最后的钱算完才发现，这个月真正的剩余资金比原来设想的少得多。

example_translations.translation: When the workers counted the materials, they found that the remaining materials that could really still be used were not many, so another truckload would have to be delivered tomorrow.
After the kitchen finished making dinner, the remaining dishes were set aside properly, so the people who arrived early the next day could keep eating them.
After the boss finished calculating the last of the money, he realized that the remaining funds for this month were far less than originally imagined.
